# AI Resources

> AI for the rest of us. The AI tools Xavier Ting uses every day to design, build and write. What each one does, when it is worth using, and how to set it up, explained without jargon.

Curated by Xavier Ting, Vice President at OCBC, Singapore. Nobody paid to be on this list. The full log in prose lives at https://xaviertingai.com/llms-full.txt.

## Tools

- [Impeccable](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/impeccable.html): Stops AI building the same generic website
- [Superpowers](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/superpowers.html): Makes Claude Code plan before it builds
- [Spec-Kit](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/spec-kit.html): Write down what you want, so the AI stops drifting
- [Chrome DevTools MCP](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/chrome-devtools-mcp.html): Lets your AI assistant see the page it built
- [Context7](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/context7.html): Gives the AI today's documentation, not last year's
- [Repomix](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/repomix.html): Packs your whole project into one file you can paste
- [Agent-Reach](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/agent-reach.html): Gets your AI past sites that block it
- [LLM Wiki](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/llm-wiki.html): Notes your AI writes and keeps up to date for you
- [Humanizer](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/humanizer.html): Takes the AI sound out of your writing
- [Figma MCP](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/figma-mcp.html): Lets AI read your real design file, not a screenshot
- [Obsidian Skills](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/obsidian-skills.html): Teaches your AI to work inside your Obsidian notes
- [Ralph Loop](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/ralph-loop.html): Runs Claude on the same task until it is done
- [Watch](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/watch.html): Lets Claude actually watch a video and answer
- [Codex for Claude Code](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/codex-for-claude-code.html): Brings in OpenAI's Codex to review code or take on jobs
- [Apple Design](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/apple-design.html): Teaches your AI what makes Apple interfaces feel right
- [Notchi](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/notchi.html): Shows what Claude Code is doing, up in the notch
- [OmniRoute](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/omniroute.html): Keeps you working when your AI quota runs out
- [Claude Mem](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/claude-mem.html): Lets your assistant remember earlier sessions
- [Headroom](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/headroom.html): Shrinks what gets sent to the model, not the answers
- [Claude Code Setup](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/claude-code-setup.html): Reads your project and suggests what to set up
- [Task Observer](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/task-observer.html): Watches how you work and improves your skills
- [Playwright CLI](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/playwright-cli.html): Lets your AI drive a browser without filling up its memory
- [Supabase Plugin](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/supabase-plugin.html): Lets your AI work directly with your Supabase database
- [Strix](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/strix.html): Sets an AI loose on your own app to find security holes
- [Skill UI](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/skill-ui.html): Writes down your product's look so Claude can match it
- [Autoresearch](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/autoresearch.html): Lets an AI agent run model experiments overnight
- [Agent Skills](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/agent-skills.html): Makes an AI follow a repeatable build process
- [Higgsfield CLI](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/higgsfield-cli.html): Makes images and videos from a line you type
- [Taste Skill](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/taste-skill.html): Gives an AI assistant a point of view about design
- [21st MCP](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/21st-mcp.html): Builds an interface component from one sentence
- [Web Design Guidelines](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/web-design-guidelines.html): Reviews your interface against a published list of rules
- [Image to Code](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/image-to-code.html): Draws the page as a picture before writing any code
- [Awesome DESIGN.md](https://xaviertingai.com/tools/awesome-design-md.html): Hands your agent a written design system to follow

## Course

- [Artificial Intelligence 101](https://xaviertingai.com/ai-101.html): 63 AI terms in plain English, about 75 minutes end to end
